function.name: list_holidays
function.description: List all available holiday packages, optionally filtered by destination keyword.

function.name: get_holiday_details
function.description: Get detailed information about a specific holiday package by its ID.

holiday_id.description: The ID of the holiday to book (e.g. H001).

traveller_name.description: Full name of the lead traveller.

start_date.description: Desired start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

function.name: list_bookings
function.description: List all bookings, optionally filtered by traveller name.

traveller_name.description: Filter bookings by lead traveller name (case-insensitive, partial match).

function.name: cancel_booking
function.description: Cancel an existing booking by its booking ID.

sender.description: Filter by sender email address (case-insensitive, partial match)

subject_filter.description: Filter by subject line (case-insensitive, partial match)

limit.description: Maximum number of emails to return (default 10)

function.name: view_calendar_events
function.description: View calendar events with optional filters.

start_date.description: Show events after this date (ISO format, e.g., "2026-04-25")

end_date.description: Show events before this date (ISO format, e.g., "2026-04-30")

title_filter.description: Filter by event title (case-insensitive, partial match)
